block.dashpanels.cable.wiki.paragraph_0: The control cable allows you to bring redstone signals out of the control panel, as well connect control panels that aren't directly connected.
block.dashpanels.control_panel.wiki.para: The control panel is the main event of the mod. You can hold a module in your hand and place it on the panel.
There isn't a wiki for the other panel types but the same applies to them as well.
block.dashpanels.panel_link.wiki.paragra: The panel link is an explicit compat block. If create is not installed this block is not there.
If you use with an empty hand it will open a menu to configure the entries. Which correspond to a module in the connected network to be used for redstone links.

item.dashpanels.cable_stripper.wiki.para: Use on a dashpanels:cable to strip it. This will then make it a Stripped Cable.
Use on a Stripped Cable to configure it's module. To configure just scroll in the gui and click when you're on your selected module.
Sneak use on a dashpanels:cable or a Stripped Cable to easily pick them up.
item.dashpanels.control_lever.wiki.parag: The control lever allows for analog output, like the knob. Use to start holding and drag up and down to change the value.
item.dashpanels.emergency_button.wiki.pa: A toggling button with a cover
item.dashpanels.indicator_bulb.wiki.para: The indicator bulb glows when given power.
item.dashpanels.joystick.wiki.paragraph_: The joystick gives out 4 outputs, like the control lever and knob you can use and hold, drag left right up and down to move it. After you let go it repositions to the center.
item.dashpanels.key.wiki.paragraph_0: Use on the dashpanels:key_switch to pair the key. Then after it's paired you can insert the key for it to be turned to send out a signal.
item.dashpanels.key.wiki.paragraph_1: This key can be copied in the crafting table by putting a single paired key with non paired keys to copy the key.
item.dashpanels.key.wiki.paragraph_2: A paired key can be cleared by putting it by itself in the crafting table
item.dashpanels.key_chain.wiki.paragraph: You can stack multiple of a dashpanels:key on this and use it as a sort of skeleton key.
You can stack this on top of a bound dashpanels:key or stack a bound dashpanels:key on this, similar to a bundle.
item.dashpanels.key_switch.wiki.paragrap: The first pairing module. Pairs with the dashpanels:key .
item.dashpanels.knob.wiki.paragraph_0: A knob, like the name says. Use to start holding and drag left and right to turn it.
item.dashpanels.label: Label
item.dashpanels.label.wiki.paragraph_0: Labels stuff, just change the name to change the label value.
item.dashpanels.momentary_switch.wiki.pa: The momentary switch is a more advanced button.
item.dashpanels.navball.wiki.paragraph_0: The navball is a module meant to be put on sable sublevels.
item.dashpanels.paint_brush.wiki.paragra: Use on dashpanels:control_panel to edit it's skin, some skins are colorable which means you can edit the color.
In your instance file there's a path titled "skin_palettes" where you can find the skin color palettes you have saved.
item.dashpanels.push_button.wiki.paragra: The push button is just a selection switch, depending on the button you press it will change to that button.
item.dashpanels.seven_segment.wiki.parag: You can give this module a redstone input. It will display the signal power. As well with CC: Tweaked installed you can place multiple next to each other in a row to display strings
item.dashpanels.switch.wiki.paragraph_0: A simple flip switch, when right clicked it toggles. Works the same as a lever.
item.dashpanels.wrench.wiki.paragraph_0: Use on modules to configure them, configuring a module can vary from inverting the signal to controlling how many switches there are, like the dashpanels:push_button .
item.dashpanels.wrench.wiki.paragraph_1: Sneak using on a module will remove it, unless it won't allow to be removed, like the dashpanels:key_switch .
